mapper.insert: INSERT INTO online_regression_steps (id, job_id, step_id, step_label, sort_order, status, task_id, screenshot_path, error_message, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{jobId}, #{stepId}, #{stepLabel}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{taskId}, #{screenshotPath}, #{errorMessage}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE online_regression_steps SET status = #{status}, task_id = #{taskId}, screenshot_path = #{screenshotPath}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, started_at = #{startedAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
